question: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of V. Only four people sit between V and B. Only three people sit to the right of C. A sits to the immediate left of W. T is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who sits at the rightmost end of the line?
solution:
Given :Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• No one sits to the left of V.
 
• Only four people sit between V and B.
 
• Only three people sit to the right of C.
 
• A sits to the immediate left of W.
 
• T is not an immediate neighbour of C.

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0fe8b3f106a36cc1a24809b6555b944f9c2f561aec7c9bbe0639a99dd3f6ea9.png] 

T sits at the rightmost end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
